description_en: Queries intelligent tagging or media fingerprint jobs. After you submit an intelligent tagging or media fingerprint job, the job is processed asynchronously. You can call this operation to query job information in real time
description_zh: 调用本接口查询智能标签或视频DNA作业。在提交智能标签或视频DNA作业后，会进行异步处理，通过此接口可以实时查询作业信息
name: ListAIJob

parameters.help_en:
The list of job IDs. You can obtain the JobId from the PlayInfo struct returned by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56124.html operation.

Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 10 job IDs at a time
parameters.help_zh:
作业ID列表。JobId可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56124.html接口中返回的PlayInfo结构体中获取。

多个ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多可以查询10个作业ID
parameters.name: job_ids

Code.description_en: The error code of the job. This field is relevant when Status is fail
Code.description_zh: 作业错误码。当Status为失败时，可关注该字段

CompleteTime.description_en: The time when the job ended. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CompleteTime.description_zh: 作业结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the job started. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 作业开始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Data.description_en: The job result data in JSON format. For more information about the data structure, see [AITemplateConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/89863.html）
Data.description_zh: 作业结果数据，JSON数据格式。具体数据结构请参见[AITemplateConfig]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/89863.html）

Message.description_en: The error message of the job. This field is relevant when Status is fail
Message.description_zh: 作业错误信息。当Status为失败时，可关注该字段

Status.description_en:
The job status. Valid values:
success: The job is successful.
fail: The job failed.
init: The job is being initialized.
processing: The job is being processed
Status.description_zh:
作业状态。取值：
success：成功。
fail：失败。
init：初始化。
processing：处理中

Type.description_en:
The job type. Valid values:

AIMediaDNA: media fingerprint.
AIVideoTag: intelligent tagging
Type.description_zh:
作业类型。取值：

AIMediaDNA：视频DNA。
AIVideoTag：智能标签

String.description_en: The list of job IDs that do not exist

items.description_en: The list of job IDs that do not exist
